text:
carmen_partnerships: Heads-up from partners: they want a hard marketplace freeze window but stressed they need H200 + Gaudi certs before copy goes live. Can infra/SI confirm cutoffs?

dev_infra: Quick status  H200 BIOS candidate inbound but not yet in partner bucket. Gaudi requires kernel 6.1 backport; building a backport image tonight. B200 fan-profile looks good after v3.

li_si: SI capacity this week limited. We can do a full cert Thu AM if artifacts (BIOS, drivers, kernels) are present Wed EOD. Otherwise we can only certify H100+B200 and mark others pending.

raj_vendor_pm: Confirming vendor will upload H200 BIOS to s3://partners/redwood/h200/1829999999/h200-bios.bin by 2024-06-10T18:00Z and will include sha256 and install notes. Gaudi backport will be available to partners in the same bucket by Wed. No embargo beyond standard 48h.

press_comms: Press note: we must not promise devices in GA copy unless SI certs complete and vendor embargo windows observed. Recommend publish H100 baseline + B200 conditional; list H200/Gaudi as "validating".

deploy-bot: image gaudi-k6-backport-2024 created and pushed to staging at 2024-06-09T23:45:00Z. Smoke tests queued.

carmen_partnerships: Plan: (1) ask vendors to drop artifacts with timestamps and shas here, (2) infra to post perf diffs after reruns, (3) SI to confirm Wed EOD whether full cert is possible. If not, we ship H100+B200 and schedule a joint announce for H200/Gaudi next week. Paste artifacts + hashes here. :spiral_calendar:
